profile.headline: Web Developer at University of Georgia - Franklin College of Arts and Sciences
profile.summary:
I have 3+ years of experience working with Drupal 8 and 9 websites, managing content for them, creating views, blocks, and programming templates in Twig all while ensuring the websites all meet W3C standards for accessibility. 

I have experience with testing and troubleshooting applications as well as merging changes to code for live environments. I also have experience in coordinating the onboarding process for support environments. My goal is to learn and grow as a professional in my field through hard work and dedication. 

As a freelancer, I've coded several bots using the Discord API and Node.js for certain servers, just for fun.

positions.title: Web Developer
positions.description:
o	Handle the migration from Drupal 7 to Drupal 8 for several departmental websites.
o	Aid with website maintenance and troubleshooting.
o	Offer basic website training for content developers both in person and online.
o	Create local instances of websites for development using Lando and Docker. 
o	Work with loading course evaluations for all Franklin College departments.
o	Helpdesk ticket management and resolution using UGA TeamDynamix. 
o	Front-end development for Gold Theme and implementation of design system.
o	Keep websites up to date with W3C accessibility standards.

company.name: University of Georgia - Franklin College of Arts and Sciences

positions.title: Applications Developer
positions.description:
o	Lead most of the process of onboarding for client support environments. 
o	Merge fixes into existing code for issues.
o	Recreate issues in support environments.
o	Run SQL statements against large databases for issue analysis and troubleshooting. 
o	Package and deliver fixes for issue resolution.
o	Read through logs for issue analysis to determine a possible fix. 
o	Remote work for 2+ years.

positions.title: Student Researcher
positions.description:
Development of Robots for Weeding in Organic Farming 
At University of Georgia in the Department of Research for the College of Engineering, I am currently
working on the NI Robotics Starter Kit 2.0 platform, so that it will navigate through crops as efficiently as
possible for the purpose of weeding through intra rows between crops.
o Wrote code for autonomous robot navigation through crop fields using LabVIEW Robotics.
o Designed actuators for the weeding process, using a servo motor and the Arduino Uno.
o Wrote code for verifying if individual pixels are any shade of green, while using a Kinect Sensor.
o Wrote code for obtaining the distance in millimeters using the depth sensor integrated in the
Kinect.
o Currently working on interfacing the Kinect Sensor into the robotics platform for more efficient,
autonomous navigation.
